description:
Job Requirements: 
 • Bachelors degree preferred or equivalent experience
 • 5+ or more years of related experience – in an IT development organization – recommended
 • Development experience in Microsoft Team Foundation Server environment.
 • Development experience with .NET framework, including C#.Net.
 • Familiarity with MS SQL 2003, 2005, and 2008
 • Additional experience with web front end and development technologies including but not limited to HTML, Java Script, Flash, PHP, and XML.
 • Experience with message queue applications
 • Experience with development of integration applications and web services
 • General understanding of technology infrastructure and application performance monitoring
 • Strong working knowledge of system development life cycle and methodologies
 • Efficient in one or more programming languages with excellent writing skills
 • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to deal with a diverse range of people, which includes the upper levels of corporate management
 • Self sufficient, requiring limited supervision over job knowledge, expectations and successful project completion

 Looking for Computer Science graduates 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
